title: Source hyper-Ext sequence with a module as target
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $K\in D(A)$ be an object of the ordinary derived category of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $N$ be an $A$-module, and let $u\in\mathbf Z$ satisfy $H^a(K)=0$ for every $a>u$. Here $H^a$ denotes standard derived cohomology [def-weil-derived-category-cohomology-functor], $N[0]$ is the complex concentrated in degree zero, and $R\operatorname{Hom}_A$ is the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object site with only the identity covering and coefficient ring $A$. There is an $A$-linear spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]
$$E_2^{i,j}=\operatorname{Ext}^i_A(H^{-j}(K),N)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad H^{i+j}(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0])),$$
where for $i\geq0$ the Ext group is computed in the abelian category of $A$-modules [def-pc-ext], and $E_2^{i,j}=0$ for $i<0$. The differential $d_s$ has bidegree $(s,1-s)$; $E_{s+1}^{i,j}$ is the kernel of the outgoing differential modulo the image of the incoming differential. Every page is zero outside $i\geq0$, $j\geq-u$, and every fixed bidegree eventually stabilizes to $E_\infty^{i,j}$. For every integer $t$, the abutment $H^t(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,N[0]))$ has a finite exhaustive separated filtration by $A$-submodules [def-sp-filtration] whose successive quotients are the $E_\infty^{t-j,j}$ with $-u\leq j\leq t$; if this interval is empty the abutment is zero. No Noetherian or finite-generation hypothesis is assumed.
